headline: A 1994 executive order changed the official definition of "field duty" in an earlier order on military pay and allowances.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 11157, an earlier order that sets rules for certain pay and allowances for members of the uniformed services. It changes how the term "field duty" is defined. No summary was provided, so the details of the new definition are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: Whether their duty counts as "field duty" can affect certain allowances they receive, so a new definition may change what some members are paid.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely when signed on October 28, 1994, though the title does not say.
